embeds.title: 1. Episodes or chapters not showing up or showing incorrectly?
embeds.description:
AnymeX uses external sources, and title mismatches with any service may cause issues, showing incorrect or no results.
> Use the **Wrong Title** option below the source name. Search for the correct title (e.g., English title) to load content.

embeds.title: 2. How to stream/read on AnymeX?
embeds.description:
Follow the step-by-step guide: [AnymeX Extension Guides](https://anymex-extensions.vercel.app/guides)

Quick links:
• [All Repos](https://anymex-extensions.vercel.app/repos) — browse and add repos
• [All Extensions](https://anymex-extensions.vercel.app/extensions) — find specific extensions

**No plugin needed:** Mangayomi, LNReader, Sora (all platforms)
**Plugin needed:** Aniyomi, CloudStream (Android & Desktop only, not iOS)

⚠️ Select the correct Extension System and Type.

**Disclaimer:** We do not encourage piracy. Support official sources when possible.

embeds.title: 3. How to install AnymeX IPA on iOS?
embeds.description:
**Jailbreak Method:**
```
Install AppSync Unified or TrollStore
Download AnymeX IPA
Install via Filza or TrollStore
```
**LiveContainer Method (No Jailbreak):**
```
Install LiveContainer
Long press app → Settings → Signer → ZSign
Import AnymeX IPA in LiveContainer
```
**Note:** LiveContainer enables sideloading without jailbreak.

embeds.title: 4. How to switch between AniList, MyAnimeList, Simkl, or Extension?
embeds.description:
To change the tracking service:
```
Click Profile → Change Service
Select AniList, MyAnimeList, Simkl, or Extension
```
**Note:** Extension service requires 4+ extensions installed to unlock.

embeds.title: 5. How can I watch local videos with AnymeX?
embeds.description:
To play local videos:
```
Go to Profile → Local Media
Click the Local button and grant directory access
```

embeds.title: 6. Why is an extension marked as obsolete?
embeds.description: This happens if a repo is missing or the extension was removed.

embeds.title: 7. How can I contribute to AnymeX?
embeds.description:
Check [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/RyanYuuki/AnymeX/issues) for `good first issue` tags.

* **Non-coding:** Report bugs or suggest features in the linked Discord channels or GitHub.
* **More info:** [DeepWiki](https://deepwiki.com/RyanYuuki/AnymeX)

embeds.title: 8. How to install AnymeX on Linux?
9. What's Hardsub or Softsub?
description: **__Hardsub__:** Subtitles are burned into the video (uneditable).
**__Softsub__:** Subtitles are separate; can be toggled or edited in AnymeX.

embeds.title: 10. Source not loading?
embeds.description:
> Many sources are **geo-blocked** or **ISP-blocked**. Try a **VPN** or switch networks.
**Note:** AnymeX does not maintain sources; report issues to the specific source repo.

embeds.title: 11. Xiaomi Devices (MIUI/HyperOS) Fixes
embeds.description:
**1. Battery:** Set to No Restrictions ([dontkillmyapp.com](https://dontkillmyapp.com/xiaomi)).
**2. Optimization:** Turn **OFF** 'MIUI/System Optimization' in Developer Options.
**3. HyperOS:** Enable **'Access List of Installed Apps'** in App Permissions.

embeds.title: 12. How to Sync Progress across all devices?
embeds.description:
AnymeX uses **GitHub Gist** for cloud syncing.

**Setup:**
> **Profile → Settings → Accounts → Progress sync** → **Connect** GitHub → **Initialise**.

**Features:**
* Auto Sync while watching/reading.
* Auto Cleanup of completed media.
* Manual Import/Export via the **Manage** button.

embeds.title: 13. How to Share Logs?
embeds.description:
**Profile → Settings → Logs**

**Steps:**
> **1.** Enable **Write log to a file**
> **2.** Reproduce the issue — trigger the exact bug or error you want to report
> **3.** Share via **Share Logs** in the same page, or send the file directly from your file manager

> **⚠️ Note:** Make sure to **reproduce the error first** before sharing logs. A log with no error in it won't help diagnose the issue.

embeds.title: 14. How to Submit a Custom Theme?
embeds.description:
Themes are submitted via the **[Creator Dashboard](https://anymex-themes.vercel.app/creator/dashboard)**. Submissions are **automated** — your theme appears here instantly after upload.

**Steps:**
> **1.** [Login](https://anymex-themes.vercel.app/creator/login) or [Register](https://anymex-themes.vercel.app/creator/register) — add your **Discord User ID** during registration or edit it later in your **[Profile](https://anymex-themes.vercel.app/profile)** to receive the **Creator role** automatically on your first upload
> **2.** Select **Upload Theme** → Fill in Name, Description, JSON, Category & Preview Image
> **3.** Click **Upload** — done! Your **Creator role** will be assigned automatically if not already

**Requirements:**
* Valid theme JSON with a unique `id`
* Preview screenshot — apply your theme first, take a screenshot, then upload it
* Unique name (letters, numbers, underscores only)

📚 [Documentation](https://anymex-themes.vercel.app/docs)

embeds.title: 15. What is Community Recommendations?
embeds.description:
**Community Recommendations** is a section where the community submits hidden gems across **Anime, Manga, Movies & Shows** — anyone can contribute and vote on entries!

**Enable it:**
> **Profile → Settings → Common → Community Recommendations** → Toggle **Show Community Recommendations**

> 🔞 **Hide NSFW Recommendations** is available in the same section — enabled by default.

**Link your accounts:**
> • `/setup` → link **AniList** and/or **MAL**
> • `/link_simkl` → link **Simkl** via PIN auth

**Add your picks:**
> • `/add_anime` or `/add_manga` → search, select & give a reason
> • `/add_show` or `/add_movie` → same flow, powered by Simkl

**Vote:**
> • **Long press** any item in the section to vote on it directly.
> • Tap **See All** to browse all submitted entries and vote.

`author_name` in `/setup` is optional — used as your display name.

**Use commands here →** <#1496731662464061521>

embeds.title: 16. How to Apply Custom Player Themes?
embeds.description:
All custom player themes can be found in <#1496836802655293542> or at **[anymex-themes.vercel.app](https://anymex-themes.vercel.app/)**.

**Apply a Theme:**
> Find a theme → Click **Apply** → AnymeX opens automatically and adds it to your collection.

**Switch Themes:**
> **Profile → Settings → Player → Player Theme** → Select any theme from your collection.

> 💡 You can keep multiple themes and switch between them anytime without re-downloading!

embeds.title: 17. How to Change Card Styles?
embeds.description:
AnymeX offers multiple card styles for browsing, history, and carousels.

**Navigate to:**
> **Profile → Settings → UI → Common**

**Available styles:**
> • **Card Style** — changes how media cards appear while browsing
> • **History Card Style** — changes cards in your history
> • **Carousel Style** — changes the big carousel on the home page

Each option has a built-in **selector with a live preview** so you can see the style before applying it.
